description: Raw output of the real codex exec review that `codex-mr-review review --base a488c33 --head feature --dry-run` started against a throwaway repository whose feature branch adds sumFirst() with an off-by-one loop bound (i <= n). Recorded by a shim placed first on PATH that ran /opt/homebrew/bin/codex and kept a copy of its stdout and its --output-last-message file. Nothing is edited.
